pr_body:
Closes #101300 

At the moment there's no task to track the deletion, so no task ID is returned. This was avoided to keep the change minimal, but also because there's already a [snapshot status](https://www.elastic.co/guide/en/elasticsearch/reference/current/get-snapshot-status-api.html) API that can be used to determine when the requested snapshots have been deleted.

Happy to go ahead and add a task if we decide it's worthwhile.

Please advise if we want to back-port, I might need to do more with the `TransportVersion` changes if so.
pr_title: Add wait_for_completion parameter to delete snapshot request

review_comment:
This is pretty long-winded just because of the asynchrony, if we added the listener after calling delete we'd need to cover the cases of
- SnapshotDeletionsInProgress is null
- The delete hasn't started
- The delete has already completed

So it seemed to make sense to just add it before we call delete and track the whole progression?
